site_name: The Arches Business Centre Merrick RoadSouthallUB2 4AU
description: Application for a Non-Material Amendment (S96a) to planning permission ref: 181380FUL dated 22/12/2021 for: Demolition of existing structures and residential-led, mixed use redevelopment to provide four buildings ranging in height from 15 to 23 storeys comprising residential (575 units), 2,100 sq m of B1(a) office floorspace, 449 sq m of flexible commercial floorspace (Use Classes A1, A2, A3, B1a and D1), erection of a boundary wall along the railway line, along with landscaping, play and amenity space, cycle parking, servicing bays, plant and refuse areas, and new access arrangements. Amendment seeks height increase to all 4 buildings; omission of metal cladding panels between windows and replacement by PC concrete; additional louvres to facades; amendments to building crown design; reconfiguration of 2-bed apartment layout and balcony location at levels 1-14 in Building 1 and 3; reconfiguration of 3-bed apartment layout at levels 15-20 in Building 1; reconfiguration of apartment balconies at levels 3-11 in Building 2; and reconfiguration of balconies at levels 12-14 in Building 2;  update to the energy strategy, with installation PVs; amendments to the wording of conditions 3, 4 and 19 Part A
